title: Poincaré inequality on the unit ball for Lipschitz functions
statement: For every n ≥ 1 there is C_P > 0 such that every Lipschitz u : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) satisfies ∫_B (u − ū)² ≤ C_P·∫_B ‖Du‖². Here B := B̆_1(0) is the open unit ball, ū := (∫_B u)/Lⁿ(B) is the mean of u over B (Lⁿ = volume, taken as a real number), and Du = fderiv ℝ u with the operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ CP : ℝ, 0 < CP ∧ ∀ (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L u → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, (u x - (∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, u y) / (volume (ball (0 : Euclid n) 1)).toReal) ^ 2 ≤ CP * ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ^ 2
